transcript: Speaker A: English ke ye paanch simple rule samajh lo, fir kabhi sawaal poochne me dikkat nahi hogi. Dekho, 'Who' ko tab use karna hai jab kisi person ke baare me jaan na ho. Jaise, 'Who are you?', 'Who is the PM of India?'. Aur 'What' ko tab use karna hai jab kisi cheez ke baare me jaan na ho. Jaise, 'What is this?', 'What is the temperature here?'. Aur usi tareeqe se 'Where' jo hai, wo place ke baare me jaan ne ke liye. Jaise, 'Where are you?', 'Where is the station?'. Aur ye jo 'When' hai, ye time jaan ne ke liye hai. Jaise, 'When will you come?', 'When is the meeting?'. Aur ye jo 'Why' hai na, ye reason jaan ne ke liye, jaise, 'Why are you late?', 'Why is this happening?'. Aur 'How' jo hota hai, wo tareeqa ya condition jaan ne ke liye hota hai. Jaise, 'How are you?', 'How did you do this?', 'How much does it cost?'.
